CREATE TABLE sites (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	address TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE product_passports (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	product VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	system_name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	serial_number VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(site_id) REFERENCES sites (id)
)

CREATE TABLE passport_events (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	passport_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	recorded_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_on VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(passport_id) REFERENCES product_passports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recorded_by_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE passport_inspections (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	passport_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(passport_id) REFERENCES product_passports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_passport_inspections_job_id ON passport_inspections (job_id)
CREATE TRIGGER passport_events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON passport_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION feniq_snapshot_immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER passport_inspections_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON passport_inspections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION feniq_snapshot_immutable()
